meta.method: nodes = top 400 particles by degree plus the 800 particles with most cyberlinks into that hub set; degree = undirected in+out over every cyberlink row; links = cyberlinks with both ends in the sample, merged to unordered pairs, weight = row multiplicity (distinct neurons), each node's heaviest link kept first then filled by (weight, degree-sum) up to 6000; layout = spectral init (2 smallest non-trivial eigenvectors of the normalised Laplacian, log1p weights) + 200 iterations ForceAtlas2-style forces on the linked subgraph (repulsion (di+1)(dj+1)/d, linear attraction x sqrt(w), gravity 0.5(di+1), linear cooling), scaled by the 1.5-98.5 percentile box (clipped) into the central 0.76 box; nodes with no in-sample link sit on an outer halo ring (radius 0.47 +-0.02, angle ordered by degree); node = [cid[:10], degree, x, y]; link = [i, j] indices into nodes
